values.description: Ellipse of skin with a sinus opening

report:
Skin, natal cleft pilonidal sinus, excision

Received in formalin is an ellipse of skin labelled natal cleft pilonidal sinus, measuring 5 x 2 x 1.5 cm, with a sinus opening on the surface. Representative sections in 3 blocks.

(1-3) Skin ellipse with sinus opening, representative cross-sections.

Sections show skin with a sinus tract extending into the dermis and subcutis, lined by granulation tissue and focally by squamous epithelium, with surrounding mixed inflammatory infiltrates and fibrosis. Hair shafts engulfed by foreign-body giant cells are seen in the wall of the sinus tract. The findings are in keeping with a pilonidal sinus. There is no evidence of dysplasia or malignancy.

SKIN, natal cleft pilonidal sinus, excision - PILONIDAL SINUS
